title: Partner Marketing Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Partner Marketing Manager to own and execute joint go-to-market with the technology and data partners our customers already run their practices on. You'll build the integration narrative, run co-marketing campaigns, launch moments, and partner events, and enable both sales teams to tell a shared story.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role for someone who can set priorities across partners at very different stages of maturity, work through influence across two organizations at once, and turn ambiguous alliance conversations into programs that produce pipeline and product adoption. Success shows up as partnerships that customers actually feel in the product story, measurable partner-influenced pipeline, and a repeatable motion that scales as the ecosystem grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the joint go-to-market strategy for a portfolio of technology and data partners, setting priorities based on customer relevance, partner readiness, and measurable impact.

- Develop positioning and messaging for integrated solutions and joint value propositions, tailored to the partner's audience and Harvey's buyers.

- Plan and execute co-marketing programs with partner marketing counterparts, including campaigns, webinars, joint customer stories, executive events, and thought leadership.

- Partner with Product and Product Marketing to shape integration launches and own how they are packaged and taken to market with each partner.

- Partner closely with Partnerships, Demand Generation, and Sales to move plans from strategy through execution.

- Enable Harvey sellers and partner-facing teams with messaging frameworks, integration collateral, proof points, and co-sell materials.

- Track and report on partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, integration adoption, and program performance, using insights to improve future programs.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 6-8+ years of experience in partner marketing, product marketing, or a related go-to-market role in B2B SaaS.

- Proven experience building and executing joint go-to-market programs with strategic technology or data partners in an enterprise sales motion.

- Strong understanding of ecosystem business models, with the judgment to prioritize across partners of differing maturity, reach, and opportunity.

- Demonstrated ability to translate technical integrations into clear customer value

- Proven ability to operate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders across multiple organizations without direct authority.

- Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus.

COMPENSATION

$136,000 - $187,000 USD

title: Head of Pharmacovigilance
description:
Location:   This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Head of Clinical Sciences, the Head of Pharmacovigilance (PV) is a physician who builds and leads Praxis’s in-house pharmacovigilance function across clinical development and commercial products. Praxis is building its pharmacovigilance system in-house rather than outsourcing it, and is using an AI-enabled safety database to create an efficient case-handling process. The Head of PV owns that system and the team that runs it.

The function is organized in two parts. Pharmacovigilance for programs in clinical development is led by the PV Clinical Development Lead, who reports to the Head of PV, leads a dedicated clinical trial safety team, and carries day-to-day medical safety oversight of the clinical-stage portfolio. Pharmacovigilance for commercial products is held directly by the Head of PV, who is personally accountable for postmarketing safety surveillance, reporting, and benefit-risk, and who directly leads the commercial-product Medical Reviewer and PV Scientist. The PV Operations Lead supports both parts of the function. Across both, the Head of PV is accountable for the pharmacovigilance system as a whole, sets the standards and governance that the two parts operate under, and is the final safety decision-maker for the company.

The safety database will already be built and validated. What this role takes on is a system that needs enhancement and modification as new products advance and launch, a quality system that has to keep pace with it, and a team that has to be assembled and qualified. The Head of PV understands pharmacovigilance operations well enough to direct them and to judge whether they are working, but does not carry them personally; the PV Operations Lead is engaged for that and is involved throughout.

The role is accountable, not advisory. The Head of PV owns the pharmacovigilance system, expedited and periodic reporting compliance, the conclusions and submission of the aggregate safety reports, and the integrity of the signal management process, and defends them to health authorities. As the senior safety physician, the Head of PV personally holds the medical determinations that sit at the center of the function for commercial products, and holds final authority over those made for clinical development programs: benefit-risk, signal adjudication, and complex case causality. The Head of PV works collaboratively with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, Data Science, and Commercial to ensure comprehensive safety oversight of Praxis products.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Leadership of the PV Function

• Lead the pharmacovigilance function as a whole, accountable for the pharmacovigilance system, its quality, and its compliance across clinical development and commercial products.

• Directly lead pharmacovigilance for commercial products, including the commercial-product Medical Reviewer and PV Scientist, holding personal accountability for postmarketing safety surveillance, expedited and periodic reporting, signal management, and benefit-risk.

• Oversee pharmacovigilance for clinical development programs through the PV Clinical Development Lead and the clinical trial safety team reporting to that role: set expectations, standards, and escalation criteria; review the safety positions taken; and retain final authority over program-significant safety decisions.

• Ensure the clinical development and commercial parts of the function operate as one system, with a single quality system, a single safety database, consistent medical judgment across both teams, and a clean handover of safety accountability as products move from development to market.

Senior Medical Determinations

• Make and articulate the benefit-risk determination for each commercial product in aggregate rep

title: Business Development / Mba Co-Founder (F/M/D) Role At Startup Chillquanta
description:
**CHILLQUANTA
**Bochum, Germany (Ruhr University Bochum) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Quantum & Semiconductor Metrology
**About ChillQuanta
**ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique - with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers.
**The opportunity
**Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company - which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.
Tasks
What you will own
**Company build-up & strategy
**- Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised.
**Commercialization
**- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.
- Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers

Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Engineer to execute the buildout, startup, and handover of electrical systems for SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. This is a hands-on role where you will commission, test, troubleshoot, and turn over critical systems that support next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with construction, engineering, operations, EPC contractors, and OEM vendors to deliver safe, reliable, and high-quality electrical systems. This is a full-time, onsite role with travel to SpaceXAI data center construction sites across the United States.

• Support commissioning schedules and punch-list resolution to meet aggressive project timelines.

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.

• Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70/70B/70E, IEEE, NETA, NESC, Uptime Institute).

• Ability to read, interpret, and redline electrical drawings, one-lines, three-lines, control schematics, and sequence of operations; update as-built models after commissioning.

• Experience coordinating with multi-discipline teams, contractors, and vendors in construction environments.

• Ability to work safely in industrial construction environments and follow LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our DevOps team owns two main areas: cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes, networking, security and the Coder development environment, and build infrastructure across GitHub, Bazel, Buildkite, testing and related developer tooling. The two engineers we’re hiring will be the start of our local DevOps presence in Japan, part of a follow-the-sun support model with our UK and US teams.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you’ll help build, operate and improve the cloud platforms, build systems and continuous integration and delivery infrastructure that support Wayve’s software development lifecycle. Working as part of a global team, you’ll create reliable, scalable, secure and efficient environments for software development, testing, deployment and release. As one of the first two DevOps engineers in Japan, you’ll combine hands-on project work with local coverage for Wayve’s global developer-support model during normal Japan working hours.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

- Building, operating and improving cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and build systems that support development, testing and production, primarily in Azure.

- Developing and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g. Terraform and Ansible), automation and developer tooling for reliable, repeatable delivery.

- Operating and scaling CI/CD services, including build agents, runners, artifact storage, distributed execution, caching and containerised workloads.

- Implementing observability, monitoring system health, and troubleshooting infrastructure, pipeline, build and deployment issues.

- Optimising cloud systems for performance, reliability, security and cost efficiency.

- Working with engineering teams across Japan, the UK and the US to make sure platforms meet application needs and support scalable software delivery.

- Contributing to the DevOps support channel, incident response and root cause analysis, and reducing manual operations through automation.

🙌 You should apply if:

Essential:

- Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- 8 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, build engineering, developer infrastructure, or related engineering roles.

- Experience with one or more of the following:

- At least one cloud platform, such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

- Infrastructure-as-Code tools, such as Terraform and Ansible.

- CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, Azure DevOps, or similar.

- Build tooling and concepts including dependency management, caching, incremental builds, and reproducible builds.

- Networking, cloud architecture, system reliability, and secure access controls.

- Experience with Linux, Git, and shell scripting.

Desirable:

- Experience with build systems such as Bazel, Buildkite, or similar.

- Experience operating CI/CD infrastructure at scale, including distributed execution, caching, and artifact management.

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based build or deployment environments.

- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.

- Understanding of software supply-chain security, secure build practices, and cloud security best practices.

- Experience supporting large, multi-language codebases or distributed systems.

- Experience improving cloud cost efficiency and operational resilience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Lead Clinical Research Associate - Contract Position
description:
ProTrials is a women-owned, WBENC-certified Contract Research Organization (CRO) that has been a trusted partner in clinical research since 1996. Founded with a clear mission to deliver high-quality, experienced, and ethical services, we’ve supported research behind innovative treatments in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries.
Our people are the heart of everything we do. We believe great work happens when team members feel valued, supported, and empowered. At ProTrials, you’ll join a collaborative community committed to making a meaningful impact on global health.
We are excited to connect with skilled individuals who share our passion for advancing clinical research with care, integrity, and excellence.

ABOUT THE JOB

ProTrials is seeking a Contract Lead Clinical Research Associate to join our team.

The Contract Lead Clinical Research Associate (LCRA) is responsible for providing direction and leadership to the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) team and Clinical Trial Associate (CTA) assigned to studies. The Contract LCRA ensures accurate and timely initiation, enrollment, conduct, completion, and provides project management support. The Contract LCRA ensures adequate study monitoring resources are in place for the study. The Contract LCRA also identifies quality issues related to clinical monitoring activities, and along with the study team, establishes action plans to address them.

HERE IS WHAT YOU WILL DO:

• Provide study oversight as the primary liaison between CRAs, internal staff, study site staff including investigators, coordinators, client personnel, and external vendors involved in all stages of the study

• Ensure clinical monitoring activities of the study CRA team(s) are performed in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), regulations, good clinical practices, key performance indicators, and study-specific requirements

• Develop, review, and manage clinical plans and guidelines, including the clinical monitoring plan and study timelines; ensure compliance with monitoring intervals according to project requirements, review data reports, CTMS, disseminate listings/reports to study CRAs, and work with CRAs and site staff to resolve data discrepancies

• Create annotated visit report templates and other documents and strategies related to site management and monitoring

• Support training and development of team members, ensure compliance with study specific training requirements, and ensure training is appropriately documented

• Guide and support CRAs, CTAs, and external contract research organizations regarding monitoring, co-monitoring, training, and audit visits; review site visit reports and monitoring letters in accordance with study and SOP requirements

• Manage oversight of the Trial Master File (TMF)/eTMF and assist with filing and quality control

• Track serious adverse events, protocol deviations, enrollment, ICFs, study contacts, investigational supplies, and investigational product for assigned study and review with appropriate members of the study team

• Perform qualification, initiation, interim, and close out visits and provide visit reports as per monitoring guidelines as needed

HERE IS WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

• RN, Bachelor, or advanced degree in biological sciences or related field, or equivalent combination of relevant experience, education, and training

• Previous CRA experience preferred

• Proven excellence in professional skills including communication, organization, prioritization, presentation, discretion, and accuracy

• Solutions-oriented approach to problem solving

• Familiarity with medical and pharmaceutical industry, and related terminology and practices

• Extensive knowledge of Food and Drug Administration regulations and their practical implementation

• Willingness to travel and perform remote and on-site monitoring, if needed

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

title: Account Manager, TMT

With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Come join us!

Location: US Remote

About the Team:

Our Customer Success team is made up of Customer Success Managers and Account Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.

As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.

About the Role:

The Account Manager, Corporate is responsible for developing three-dimensional relationships with customers and key stakeholders in order to effectively retain and grow our customer base. In this role, you will serve as our Corporate clients' main point of contact for inbound queries, outbound engagement, relationship updates, and renewal discussions. You'll need to be versatile. Corporations

• Energy: Clients follow policy changes, M&A activity, and supply chain risk.

• Industrials: Clients scan for M&A, capital expenditure trends, and global demand.

• Consumer Goods & Retail: Clients track pricing moves, retailer strategy, and consumer demand.

Consulting & Professional Services

• Consulting: Firms use AlphaSense to build proposals and client deliverables with less research time.

• Law Firms: Firms use legal research to prepare cases and shape strategy.

• Insurance: Carriers use AlphaSense to inform underwriting decisions and risk analysis.

title: Lab Technician, Mechatronics and Prototyping (Mechatroniker)
description:

You will build and test mechanical and electromechanical prototypes from early-stage design concepts, and carry out rapid prototyping and mechanical assembly trials. You will develop fixtures, test setups and scalable assembly processes, operate milling machines, lathes and test stands, and maintain workshop processes, tools, inventory and calibration. It suits technicians trained in machining, wiring, assembly and test stand technology.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and test mechanical and electromechanical prototypes based on early-stage design concepts.

- Carry out rapid prototyping and mechanical assembly trials.

- Optimize and maintain workshop processes, tools, inventory, and calibration.

- Operate key workshop equipment such as milling machines, lathes, and test stands.

- Work closely with engineers to improve prototypes and prepare them for production.

- Perform incoming goods inspections, maintain PPE and tools, and ensure safe working practices.

- Maintain a clean, structured, and efficient lab and workshop environment.

WHO YOU ARE

- Hands-on problem solver with strong practical skills - equally effective working independently and as part of a team in a workshop environment.

- Proactive, communicative, and team-oriented - you thrive when collaborating with engineers and technicians in dynamic development environments.

- Detail-oriented and safety-conscious - with high standards for quality, precision, and safe working practices.

- Adaptable and flexible - you perform well in fast-moving, evolving technical environments with a high degree of ownership.

- Excellent German and English language skills.

- Strong technical background, such as vocational training or a technical college/university degree, with experience in machining, wiring, assembly, and test stand technology.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

THE OPPORTUNITY

CodeRabbit helps engineering teams trust the code their AI agents write. We want the same confidence in our own numbers. As our Senior Data Analyst, you’ll build the dashboards and reports that give leadership strategic insight across Finance, Revenue, Marketing and Product. You’ll launch our foundational BI tool, then build the agentic workflows that model our data and generate new dashboards and insights on request. You’ll join a small Business Systems team that builds with frontier AI tools every day.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Launch our foundational BI tool and build the first exec and team dashboards on it.

- Build exec- and board-level reporting for Finance and GTM, including ARR waterfalls, pipeline, funnel and deal risk.

- Run deep-dive analyses on the gaps between targets and actuals, pipeline health, margins, and billing issues.

- Build and maintain dbt models that form a governed data layer, so people and agents can query with confidence.

- Identify gaps in our data warehouse, ETL pipelines, and semantic layer to enforce canonical definitions and shared metrics across the business.

- Build and maintain the context layer and agentic harness that let anyone at CodeRabbit generate dashboards and insights on request, with tests and review before anything ships.

- Work as a collaborative partner to Finance and GTM: understand their problems and needs, then build workflows and data products that scale with our teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years as a data analyst or senior data analyst, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

- Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.

- Experience building and maintaining dbt models and the semantic layer.

- Experience building dashboards and self-serve analytics in a modern BI tool such as Omni, Sigma or Looker.

- Working knowledge of finance and GTM metrics: ARR, net and gross retention, bookings, pipeline coverage, CAC and gross margin, and how a forecast miss gets traced to its causes.

- Real experience using agentic tools such as Claude Code or Codex for analysis and for building, with something you built that you can show us.

- Comfortable working with messy data and understanding trade-offs when drawing insights.

- Ability to work and communicate with senior leadership, and technical and non-technical peers.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with ETL and ELT pipelines, orchestration tools (such as Airflow, Dagster or Fivetran) and reverse ETL.

- Experience at an AI company or early-stage startup, where definitions change and you build the first version of everything.

- Experience with CRMs like Salesforce and billing systems like Chargebee

- Python or TypeScript, Git and code review, or a dashboards-as-code tool such as Evidence, Streamlit or Observable.

- Experience building agent tooling: MCP servers, an agent harness, or CI for analytics code.

- Experience with finance reporting, such as an ERP or month-end close, and with usage-based or PLG-to-sales-led pricing, across PLG and SLG motions.

Target salary for this role is $170k-$200k, plus equity. Actual salary will be based on candidate skills, experience and location

title: Senior Product Designer – Toast Retail
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 

Toast is making it faster and easier for retailers to get started on Toast: the path from a store's existing product data to a correctly configured, actively selling location. We are seeking a highly skilled, AI-native Senior Product Designer to lead that experience: someone with a strong portfolio, a track record of leading design for complex product areas, a focus on exceptional UI design, and the hands-on ability to build working prototypes with AI tools like Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude. This role involves designing for the unique needs of a diverse retail customer base, including convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores, hybrid models, and beyond.

You will lead design for Toast Retail's Experience Platform team, working day to day with product and engineering partners in our Dublin office and the U.S., and reporting to Toast Retail's design leadership in the U.S. Together you will turn product strategy into the setup and onboarding experiences that make retailers feel Toast is built for them.

Why This Role Matters

A retailer's first 90 days on Toast decide whether they stay. Before a store can sell, thousands of items need clean names, categories, brands, pack sizes, taxes, deposits, age restrictions, and images, and most of that data arrives messy, from another system or a spreadsheet. The experiences you design will decide how quickly a new store goes live, how much of that work Toast can do for them, and whether the people setting up the store, often owners juggling a business that is already open, feel in control or buried in it.

You will be Toast Retail's design presence in our Dublin office: the on-site design partner for its product and engineering teams, and part of Toast's wider design community. As a senior designer working across regions and time zones, you will set design direction for your area with a high degree of autonomy: keeping local teams unblocked, making well-informed design and scope tradeoffs within the broader product vision, shaping the roadmap alongside your product and engineering partners, and bringing US-based design, product, and business stakeholders in when direction, customer impact, or strategic choices need broader alignment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Lead design for your product area: Take your area from early discovery through shipped UI, set its design direction and quality bar, and connect each workflow to the broader Toast Retail vision. Help shape what the team builds, not only how it looks.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools such as Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude to build working, interactive prototypes with realistic data, so ideas can be tested with customers and engineers before the team commits to them. Use AI across the rest of your practice too, from synthesizing research to exploring concepts, validating outputs carefully and modeling responsible, secure use of AI for the team.

• Design AI-first workflows: Identify where AI can materially reduce customer effort, such as importing and cleaning up a store's existing item data, enriching items with brands, images, and attributes, and guiding new retailers through setup. Design just as carefully for when it is unsure: how customers review low-confidence results, correct mistakes, and come to trust the system.

• Engage directly with customers: Research with retailers, and with the onboarding and support teams who help them go live, to understand where setup breaks down, and translate those insights into design direction and testable ideas.

• Make complex data feel simple: Turn large catalogs, imports, bulk edits, and errors into experiences that are clear, forgiving, and fast, on desktop and in the hand.

• Collaborate early and often: Partner closely with product managers and engin

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

Lendable is launching its credit card product in Mexico and building a founding

local team. We're looking for someone to own the day-to-day operation of that

product: the customer conversations, yes, but also the queues, the exceptions,

the data behind them, and the tooling that makes all of it faster next month

This is not a scripted support seat. Our support stack is heavily instrumented

patterns nobody has noticed yet, and processes that still need a human to design

them. You'll spend part of your week talking to customers and part of it

We're a small team in a market we're still learning. The person who does well

- Take a case from first contact through to actual resolution, including the backend or ops step that fixes it - not just the reply to the customer

- Keep queues clean and decisions auditable, and know which cases genuinely need another team versus which ones you can close yourself

2. Investigate, don't just respond

- Dig into dashboards, internal tools, and customer records to work out what actually happened before deciding what to say

- Reconstruct timelines across systems - application, card, transactions, payments and form a view on root cause

- Spot irregularities early (fraud signals, broken flows, provider failures) and escalate with evidence and a hypothesis, not just a screenshot

3. Work alongside AI agents as part of your toolkit

- Use AI assistants and internal agents to triage, draft, summarise, and pull data - and know when their output is wrong and shouldn't be shipped

- Improve the prompts, macros, and knowledge sources those agents rely on when you see them getting things wrong or going stale

- Help us decide which repetitive work should be automated next, and what needs to stay human

4. Turn recurring problems into fewer problems

- Track what customers contact us about, quantify it, and bring the top patterns to Product, Risk, and Engineering with data attached

- Write and maintain the runbooks, help articles,

In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

• Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

• Builder (Level 2) - Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

• Integrator (Level 3) - Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role
As a Senior Security Engineer (Security Operations) at Sword, you will be at the forefront of safeguarding our cloud infrastructure and applications. Your expertise will ensure robust security measures, incident response, and continuous improvement.
Are you looking to join an incredible IT team, passionate about simplifying everyone's work? Look no further, we're hiring! We're a proactive team, constantly staying ahead to ensure everything runs smoothly. As an IT Team we understand the importance of technology in today's workplace and the impact that technical issues can have on productivity and efficiency. Want to join the team? Find out if you've got what it takes!
To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you’ll be doing

• Design and continuously improve detection and alerting controls, ensuring high fidelity and contextual relevance to reduce noise and enable rapid response.

• Architect, refine, and maintain custom YARA-L detection rules and SOAR playbooks in Google SecOps to automate triage, alert enrichment, and initial incident response.

• Drive prioritization of alerts using a data-driven, scalable triage framework, aligned with business impact and threat context.

• Lead end-to-end incident investigations in Google SecOps, leveraging complex telemetry correlation to proactively hunt for threats, contain active incidents, and drive root-cause remediation.

• Proactively engage in threat intelligence and threat hunting, identifying new tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), enriching existing controls, and feeding insights into the detection pipeline.

• Own incident handling from detection to resolution, collaborating with engineering, IT, and business teams to contain, eradicate, and recover from threats.

• Define and maintain operational metrics for incident response, using them to drive continuous improvement in speed, accuracy, and organizational readiness.

What you need to have

• Required: Public Trust Clearance - Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Lead-Producer Services Readiness
description:
Role Overview

The Producer Services Readiness Lead serves as the senior Producer Services subject matter expert for translating approved requirements into practical workflows, standard operating procedures, training, service processes, controls, and launch plans. The role leads and coordinates readiness activities for new and changing business-process requirements within Producer Services.

The Lead applies sound operational judgment and escalates decisions involving policy, risk, resources, or cross-functional ownership to the appropriate Producer Services leader. The Lead coordinates readiness activities and assesses whether staff, workflows, materials, system dependencies, and escalation paths have been prepared before new producer-facing requirements go live, escalating unresolved readiness risks as appropriate.

The role provides targeted onboarding and Support readiness during launches and peak periods but does not become the standing owner of routine onboarding, Support production, regulatory interpretation, or technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Readiness & Subject Matter Expertise

• Serve as the Producer Services subject matter expert for the implementation of new and changing business-process requirements.

• Translate approved policy, program, regulatory, financial, and operational decisions into clear Producer Services workflows and operating requirements.

• Develop and recommend how approved requirements should be executed across affected Producer Services teams, working with team leaders to confirm the final operating approach.

• Map current- and future-state processes, including roles, handoffs, decision rights, controls, exceptions, and escalation paths.

• Identify missing decisions, process gaps, conflicting requirements, and dependencies that could prevent successful implementation.

• Recommend practical operating approaches that balance producer clarity, control requirements, service quality, and available capacity for review and approval by Producer Services leadership.

• Maintain awareness of new and changing Producer Services processes across registration, reporting, validation, adjustments, corrections, payments, delinquency, and regulator referrals to support readiness planning and implementation activities.

• Process Implementation & Operationalization

• Assess the operational feasibility and impacts of new or changing requirements affecting Producer Services.

• Coordinate and support the implementation and operationalization of approved Producer Services processes, partnering with process owners and functional leaders to ensure readiness activities are completed.

• Draft and maintain operational process documentation, including SOPs, process maps, job aids, checklists, decision trees, intake procedures, queue-routing rules, and escalation protocols.

• Document process ownership, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths across Producer Services and partner functions.

• Coordinate the transition of approved requirements from process design into day-to-day operations.

• Assess readiness and identify gaps related to workflows, documentation, controls, staffing, data, knowledge, and escalation paths before launch, escalating unresolved risks to the appropriate leader.

• Monitor adoption after launch, identify operational gaps, and coordinate approved process updates, training activities, or corrective actions with the appropriate process owners.

• Transition implemented processes to the appropriate steady-state owner after stabilization.

Training, Launch & Adoption

• Develop and coordinate operational training for new and changing Producer Services processes.

• Prepare facilitator materials, staff job aids, process guidance, scenarios, and readiness resources.

• Facilitate or support training sessions for Producer Services and other affected teams.

• Support readiness activities designed to ensure affected staff have access to process guidance, resources,

• Integrate Cisco Secure Firewall with Cisco XDR for cross-platform threat detection, event correlation, and automated incident response across the security portfolio.

• Automate firewall provisioning, configuration backup, and policy deployment using infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and vendor APIs for repeatable, auditable workflows.

At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer programs team as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

What You’ll Do

Data integration and ingestion

• Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.

• Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity

• Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.

• Connect Celonis to AI. Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance

• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

• Be the security translator. Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.

Customer and team impact

• Scope with confidence. Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.

• Be the voice of the field. Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.

description:
Role Title: Humanitarian Aid Representative
Role Type: Contractor

micro1 is engaging Humanitarian Aid Representatives to contribute their field expertise in humanitarian and civilian protection for a unique project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. The focus of this engagement is to design, review, and refine scenarios involving civilian harm, protected persons, and the boundaries of legitimate activity, ensuring responses are grounded in International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and best practices in humanitarian action. Strong written and verbal communication skills are highly valued, as your insights and documentation will directly influence AI performance and sensitivity to complex humanitarian concerns.

• Develop nuanced cases and scenarios focused on civilian protection, proportionality, and humanitarian constraints for AI model evaluation.

• Assess and grade AI-generated responses for accuracy, depth of reasoning, and sensitivity to civilian-harm considerations.

• Identify and flag instances of excessive caution or insufficient restraint in model responses, highlighting humanitarian implications.

• Document challenging or ambiguous cases from a humanitarian perspective to inform future training and refinement.

• Collaborate with project stakeholders to clarify humanitarian concepts and contribute to guidance on IHL-related reasoning.

• Maintain precise, clear, and context-rich records of findings and recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in humanitarian operations, protection, or policy with organizations such as ICRC/Red Cross, UN agencies, or major NGOs.

• Strong grounding in International Humanitarian Law and civilian-protection principles.

• Experience in teaching, training, or field leadership related to humanitarian action or IHL dissemination.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, especially in crafting and reviewing complex case material.

• Proven ability to apply proportionality reasoning in conflict or protection scenarios.

• Experience documenting or reporting on edge cases or challenging humanitarian situations.

• Conflict-zone fieldwork, protection-cluster participation, or IHL-dissemination experience is highly valued.

title: Checkout, Step by Step (Paid Data Task, Remote, Contract)
description:
ABOUT KLED
Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.
We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.
We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.
We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.
Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:
• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors
• Processed 5M uploads per day
• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more
Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Checkout, Step by Step". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.
What you will do
Go through a website step by step and screenshot each screen as you go. Stop before you pay for anything.
Steps

• Pick a flow: sign-up, search-to-basket, booking, account settings

• Screenshot each screen as you go, in order

• Stop before entering real card details

• Describe what you did at each step

• Submit the whole sequence

What gets rejected

• Never enter real payment details

• Do not skip steps in the middle

• Do not mix two different sites in one sequence

Accepted: Sequential screenshots of one flow in order, with the action at each step described. No real card details entered.
Pay
$1.10 per accepted flow. At a typical pace of about 4 minutes per flow, that is about $17 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 5 flows pays about $5.50. One flow of 4 to 6 screens per submission. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).
Where and when
Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.
What you need

• An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

• 18 or older

• Screenshots taken on your own phone

How to start

• Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

• Create your account and open Tasks.

• Search "Checkout, Step by Step", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

• Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .

• Track progress toward fundraising goals and regularly report on results, prospective gifts, and opportunities for growth to senior leadership.

• Input contact reports in TPPF’s donor database, coordinating activity across the development team.

title: Controller
description:
Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t. We’re launching moonshot science projects which may change the trajectory of scientific progress. Today we support 14 FROs and counting across the US, the UK and Chile, with an annual budget of $75 million and growing. Large-scale brain mapping, climate measurement and software for math all have something in common: they each need a nonprofit legal entity, payroll providers, health benefits, boards, contracts, office space, press releases, websites… For every FRO we support, Convergent provides the backend infrastructure that lets them move fast.
 
About the Role
As the Controller, you oversee the full accounting operation across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries, from the general ledger and monthly close to internal controls, audit and regulatory compliance. You will also build and run our federal grants program: designing the compliance infrastructure, monitoring every award, and executing against 2 CFR Part 200 from award setup to closeout. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will lead a team of Finance & Accounting Managers and serve as our in-house expert on GAAP and federal grant compliance, weighing in on matters of significance with team, FRO and Convergent leaders.
This is a fully remote position with domestic travel required quarterly for team and organizational onsites, and as needed.

Convergent Research aims to help fill a structural gap in today's R&D system. We enable fundamental research that requires unusual levels of scale and coordination yet is not rapidly monetizable by industry. We’re bringing together top talent from academia, industry, and startups to build a new model for innovative R&D.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We believe in hiring individuals based on their unique talents-not on race, color, religion, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or our company policies. We are more than a proud Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to foster a healthy, safe, and respectful environment where all employees are valued and treated with dignity. Harassment of any kind is not tolerated here. #LI-remote #LI-KP1

title: Senior Cost Engineer
description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary The Senior Cost Engineer will play a pivotal role in the Rivian Cost Engineering organization, as a part of our team of Cost Engineers, located remotely in Mexico. The role will be responsible for completion of cost models that accurately analyze the costs associated with components across Rivian vehicles, and will require up to 25% travel. Your expertise in cost estimation will be crucial in guiding our design and procurement, ensuring competitiveness in the market, and maintaining our commitment to providing high-quality products. El/la ingeniero/a de costos sénior desempeñará un papel fundamental en la organización Cost Engineering de Rivian , como parte de nuestro equipo de Ingenieros de Costos, ubicado de forma remota en México. Esta persona tendrá la responsabilidad de realizar modelos de costos que analicen con precisión los costos asociados a los componentes de todos los vehículos Rivian , y requerirá hasta un 25% de desplazamientos. Su experiencia en la estimación de costos será fundamental para orientar nuestros diseños y adquisiciones, garantizando así la competitividad en el mercado y manteniendo nuestro compromiso de ofrecer productos de alta calidad. Responsibilities Cost Engineering: Provide guidance to the design requirements or design engineer for proposed new or modified designs to achieve required function at minimum or target cost. Develop should cost models and projections for multiple vehicle commodities specialized in mechanical content - High Pressure Die Casting, Forging, Machining, Stampings, Injection Molding. Utilize information ranging from written assumptions, sample parts, CAD models and engineering drawings. Gather details and compile data to estimate all production costs considering raw materials, labor, and tooling for estimations or should cost models. Interface with manufacturing plants and suppliers to ensure most economical tooling, processing and operations that will contribute to profitable production. Support Rivian Procurement in analysis and review of supplier cost breakdowns to drive cost reduction opportunities through negotiations with suppliers. Mentor Rivian Procurement team members based on manufacturing and process cost expertise. Perform teardown of complex automotive components to analyze parts and develop a Bill of Material (BoM) when detailed engineering CAD is not available. Create cost estimates using physical parts and in-depth process knowledge. Perform Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) activities to generate cost reduction ideas through identification of process and product efficiencies that will reduce overall costs. Work with all stakeholders to support cost reduction targets. Support competitive vehicle benchmarking to provide input for future model development and target costs. Project Management: Assume ownership of projects; plan milestones and identify potential risks to ensure timely delivery of cost models within agreed completion dates. Proactively manage task completion and regularly update cross-functional teams on project status, timing, resource allocation, challenges, and the likelihood of on-time, high-quality delivery. Ingeniería de costos: Orientar a los responsables de los requisitos de diseño o a los ingenieros de diseño sobre diseños nuevos o modificados propuestos, a fin de lograr la función requerida a un costo mínimo u objetivo. Desarrollar modelos y proyecciones de costos (should-cost) para múltiples productos
